$schema_note: Single source of truth for design-tools. scripts/resolve.sh reads `roots` + `tools`; scripts/build.py regenerates commands/ and wiki/ from `vendors` + `tools` + each installed SKILL.md. Command names: `<vendor>-<tool>` (no double prefix when the tool already starts with the vendor key; `command` overrides), plus one `<vendor>` command per vendor that runs the vendor's `master` skill as designed, or lists the vendor's tools when there is no master. Edit here, then run `python3 scripts/build.py`.

roots.name: design-studio
roots.note: The bake-off inventory. Canonical install of every vendor skill; `design-studio/scripts/install-all.sh` and `scripts/skillset.sh` maintain it.

studio.note: The bake-off dashboard (self-contained HTML, per-skill demos embedded). `/design-tools:demo` opens it via scripts/dashboard.sh; override the location with $DESIGN_STUDIO_DIR. Its vendor column comes from candidates/skills-dashboard.json, which mis-attributes twelve ui-craft lenses to impeccable — the wiki here is the authority.

ui-craft.name: ui-craft
ui-craft.author: educlopez
ui-craft.summary: The substrate. One base skill, three presets, eight phase commands, fifteen passes, three judges, two review agents. Owns the only durable project memory in the inventory (`.ui-craft/brief.md`, `.ui-craft/spec.md`).
ui-craft.contract: Every lens opens by asking to read `ui-craft/SKILL.md` first — let it. A lens without its base loses the anti-slop rules, the knobs, and the Craft Report format. The resolver prints the base path for you.

taste.name: taste-skill
taste.author: Leonxlnx
taste.summary: Art-direction doctrine. The densest anti-slop text in the inventory (`design-taste-frontend`, 1206 lines), plus reference and image-generation skills, style presets, and the `full-output-enforcement` modifier.
taste.contract: Orchestrator-class skills here want a context of their own. Image-generation skills need an image tool in the session.

impeccable.name: impeccable
impeccable.author: pbakaus
impeccable.summary: One skill with internal modes (`impeccable shape`, `impeccable audit`, `impeccable polish`, …), Apache 2.0, ships `scripts/` for image generation, live overlay and a CSP detector. The strongest authorial POV in the set and the most expensive: roughly 3× the tool calls of `design-taste-frontend`.
impeccable.contract: Orchestrator. Never in the same context as another orchestrator. Its `allowed-tools` assume `.claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/` relative to the project — when loaded from an external root, call the scripts by the absolute path the resolver prints.

emil.name: Emil Kowalski skills
emil.author: emilkowalski
emil.summary: The motion reference: component feel, springs, gestures, interruptibility, plus read-only planners and a reverse dictionary for naming effects.
emil.contract: Taste questions go here; performance questions go to ibelick. `prototype` and `review-animations` are `disable-model-invocation` — they only run when named.

ibelick.name: ui-skills
ibelick.author: ibelick
ibelick.summary: Three short, prescriptive checklists for the fast targeted fix when a 450-line doctrine is overkill.
ibelick.contract: Minutes, not hours. If the question is compliance or philosophy, go to osmani or emil instead.

osmani.name: web-quality-skills
osmani.author: addyosmani
osmani.summary: Performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), SEO, best practices, and an umbrella audit. MIT. The only vendor that covers SEO and CWV.
osmani.contract: Metrics and compliance. `web-quality-audit` first when the worst axis is unknown; the named skill when it is.

iart.name: web-animation-skills
iart.author: iart-ai
iart.summary: Technique-level animation recipes: GSAP/ScrollTrigger, Lottie, SVG, page transitions, micro-interactions, glassmorphism, ASCII, 60fps and reduced-motion.
iart.contract: How-to, not taste. Reach for these once the motion decision is made and a specific technique is named.

lottie.name: motion-design-skill
lottie.author: LottieFiles
lottie.summary: Motion principles adapted for UI: timing, easing, choreography, the Disney twelve. MIT. Note: this is the `motion-design` skill installed in the inventory — not an Emil Kowalski skill, despite earlier notes.
lottie.contract: System-agnostic (CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lottie, springs). Pair with `emil-design-eng` when one component needs feel rather than a plan.

design-motion-principles.name: design-motion-principles
design-motion-principles.author: kylezantos
design-motion-principles.install: git clone (nested repo; symlinked into the inventory 2026-08-20)
design-motion-principles.summary: Emil Kowalski / Jakub Krehel / Jhey Tompkins lenses in one skill; build mode and an audit mode that emits an HTML report with looping demos.
design-motion-principles.contract: Use the audit mode when the owner wants to *see* the motion review, not read it.

motion-dev.name: motion-dev-animations
motion-dev.author: 199-biotechnologies
motion-dev.summary: Motion.dev (Framer Motion successor) for React, Next.js, Svelte, Astro — 120fps GPU-accelerated patterns.
motion-dev.contract: Framework-specific. Only when the project is on Motion.dev / Framer Motion.

threejs.name: threejs-skills
threejs.author: cloudai-x
threejs.install: git clone (nested repo; ten skills symlinked into the inventory 2026-08-20)
threejs.summary: Ten vanilla Three.js technique references: fundamentals, loaders, materials, lighting, shaders, geometry, textures, animation, interaction, postprocessing.
threejs.contract: Not a design vendor — it builds a competent scene inside whatever page it is given. React projects use the `core-3d-animation` plugin instead.

awwwards.name: claude-skill-awwwards
awwwards.author: tponscr-debug
awwwards.summary: Awwwards-winning design principles applied as a single orchestrator-style skill.

calm-design.name: calm-design
calm-design.author: calmtiger86
calm-design.summary: Full-stack 'calm premium' design agent that writes a DESIGN.md and runs visual self-critique and pre-flight checks. Korean-first prompts.
calm-design.contract: Orchestrator-class. Own context. Expect Korean in its own output unless told otherwise.

frontend-god-mode.name: frontend-god-mode
frontend-god-mode.author: Shawnchee
frontend-god-mode.summary: A consolidated 'do everything frontend' master skill — prior art for the orchestrators that followed.
frontend-god-mode.contract: Orchestrator-class. Own context. Broad trigger — it wants to fire on any UI request, which is exactly why the router exists.

design-skill-os.name: design-skill-os
design-skill-os.author: frhscopex
design-skill-os.summary: A design operating system synthesised from ten canonical design books: research, typography, colour theory, composition, branding, logo design, storytelling, process.
design-skill-os.contract: Reference reading, not a pass. Use when a decision needs a principle behind it.

finalize.for: READY / NOT READY / BLOCKED before merge; findings only

remember.does: Appends a learned design constraint to .ui-craft/brief.md §6 so future sessions obey it.
